toneNote: tone.weight scales a channel's videos in attention thresholds and comment sentiment (1 = full). hype: true also halves a video whose title is hype (caps, !!, CRAZY, INSANE, EXPLODE). Claim scoring is never weighted: every claim is scored the same and stays unverified until our data backs it.
